definitions.explanation: An organization or facility dedicated to scientific or academic research.

examples.japanese: {国立|こくりつ}{研究所|けんきゅうじょ}で{働|はたら}いている。
examples.english: I work at a national research institute.

examples.japanese: この{研究所|けんきゅうじょ}では{新薬|しんやく}の{開発|かいはつ}をしている。
examples.english: This research institute is developing new medicines.

examples.japanese: {大学|だいがく}の{研究所|けんきゅうじょ}が{最新|さいしん}の{技術|ぎじゅつ}について{発表|はっぴょう}した。
examples.english: The university's research institute made an announcement about the latest technology.

notes: An alternate reading of {研究所|けんきゅうしょ} also exists and is used in some proper names. The じょ reading is more common in general usage. Often part of organization names, such as {理化学研究所|りかがくけんきゅうじょ} (RIKEN).

cross_references.description: Alternate reading けんきゅうしょ
